description: arXiv search topics for the spectral graph, rational self-energy, dynamic hosting, and IBR stability thesis literature review.

topics.label: IBR and converter-dominated power-system stability
topics.review_question: How do grid-following, grid-forming, PLL, weak-grid, and low-inertia converter dynamics change small-signal and damping stability claims?
topics.query: (cat:eess.SY OR cat:cs.SY OR cat:math.OC) AND (all:"inverter-based" OR all:"inverter based" OR all:"grid-forming" OR all:"grid following" OR all:"grid-following" OR all:"PLL" OR all:"phase locked loop" OR all:"converter-dominated" OR all:"power electronics dominated" OR all:"low inertia")

topics.label: Schur complements, rational self-energy, and nonlinear eigenvalue problems
topics.review_question: What NEP, rational eigenvalue, Schur-complement, matrix-polynomial, and transfer-function results support controller condensation into Pi(s) or Sigma(s)?
topics.query: (cat:math.NA OR cat:math.SP OR cat:math.OC OR cat:cs.SY OR cat:eess.SY) AND (all:"nonlinear eigenvalue problem" OR all:"rational eigenvalue" OR all:"Schur complement" OR all:"matrix polynomial" OR all:"self energy" OR all:"self-energy" OR all:"transfer function" OR all:"resolvent")

topics.label: Spectral graph theory for power networks
topics.review_question: How do Laplacian spectra, algebraic connectivity, effective resistance, Kirchhoff indices, and synchronization metrics support or fail as power-network robustness screens?
topics.query: (cat:eess.SY OR cat:cs.SI OR cat:cs.SY OR cat:math.OC OR cat:math.SP OR cat:nlin.AO) AND (all:"spectral graph" OR all:"Laplacian" OR all:"algebraic connectivity" OR all:"effective resistance" OR all:"Kirchhoff index" OR all:"power grid" OR all:"power network" OR all:"synchronization")

topics.label: Dynamic hosting capacity and converter hosting limits
topics.review_question: How is hosting capacity extended from voltage and thermal constraints to dynamic, spectral, damping, protection, and controller-aware constraints?
topics.query: (cat:eess.SY OR cat:cs.SY OR cat:math.OC) AND (all:"hosting capacity" OR all:"dynamic hosting" OR all:"distributed energy resources" OR all:"DER hosting" OR all:"renewable hosting" OR all:"inverter hosting" OR all:"converter hosting")

topics.label: Virtual inertia, damping, and primary-control placement
topics.review_question: Where should inertia, virtual inertia, damping, or primary control be placed, and how do these actions differ under heterogeneous network modes?
topics.query: (cat:eess.SY OR cat:cs.SY OR cat:math.OC OR cat:math.DS) AND (all:"virtual inertia" OR all:"inertia allocation" OR all:"inertia placement" OR all:"damping placement" OR all:"primary control" OR all:"frequency nadir" OR all:"RoCoF")

topics.label: Braess effects, line reinforcement, and network expansion
topics.review_question: When can line additions, line reinforcement, or topology changes worsen flows, synchronization, damping, or stability margins?
topics.query: (cat:eess.SY OR cat:cs.SY OR cat:physics.soc-ph OR cat:nlin.AO OR cat:math.OC) AND (all:"Braess" OR all:"line reinforcement" OR all:"transmission expansion" OR all:"network reinforcement" OR all:"line capacity" OR all:"topology control" OR all:"power grid" OR all:"power network")

topics.label: Networked control, resolvents, nonnormality, and passivity
topics.review_question: What control-system results explain resolvent amplification, nonnormality, small-gain/small-phase stability, passivity, and decentralized stability in networked systems?
topics.query: (cat:cs.SY OR cat:eess.SY OR cat:math.OC OR cat:math.DS) AND (all:"networked control" OR all:"nonnormal" OR all:"non-normal" OR all:"resolvent" OR all:"pseudospectrum" OR all:"small gain" OR all:"small phase" OR all:"passivity" OR all:"decentralized stability")

topics.label: Krein signatures, sign characteristics, and dissipation-induced instability
topics.review_question: Which mathematical results on sign characteristics, Krein signatures, indefinite damping, and dissipation-induced instability can be adapted to rational converter-condensed NEPs?
topics.query: (cat:math.SP OR cat:math.NA OR cat:math.DS OR cat:math-ph OR cat:physics.class-ph) AND (all:"Krein signature" OR all:"sign characteristic" OR all:"dissipation-induced" OR all:"indefinite damping" OR all:"Hamiltonian" OR all:"gyroscopic" OR all:"matrix polynomial")

topics.query: (cat:eess.SY OR cat:cs.SY OR cat:math.NA OR cat:math.OC) AND (all:"impedance based" OR all:"impedance-based" OR all:"black-box" OR all:"converter model" OR all:"frequency response" OR all:"Loewner" OR all:"modal identification" OR all:"data-driven" OR all:"system identification")
